section_header: FRONT AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Front Axle Shock Absorber
title: Front Axle Shock Absorber

items: REMOVE BRAKE CALIPER AND FRONT AXLE HUB (See page FA-6)

content.description: Diagram showing front axle suspension assembly with coil spring and SST tool positions. Main image shows full suspension assembly, circular inset shows detail of SST application on upper mount.

items.label: (a)
items.text: Using SST, compress the coil spring.

items.label: (c)
items.text: Using SST to hold the support, remove the nut.

items.label: (d)
items.text: Remove the suspension support, dust seal, spring seat, spring bumper.

content.text: INSPECTION OF FRONT SHOCK ABSORBER ASSEMBLY
1. INSPECT STEERING KNUCKLE PART OF SHOCK ABSORBER
Using a magnetic flaw detector or flaw detecting penetrant, inspect the steering knuckle part of the shock absorber for damage or cracks.

content.description: Diagram showing hands using magnetic flaw detector tool on steering knuckle part of shock absorber assembly.

items.label: (a)
items.text: Pull out the shock absorber piston rod at a constant speed and check to see that the pull feeling throughout the stroke is the same.

content.description: Two side-by-side diagrams showing shock absorber in compressed and extended positions with hands demonstrating manual operation test.

items.label: (b)
items.text: Check to see that there is no change in the pull when the piston rod is suddenly moved up and down with a stroke of 5 — 10 mm (0.20 — 0.39 in.).

content.description: Diagram showing hands using SST tool to remove shock absorber from outer shell, with detailed view of the procedure.

items.label: (c)
items.text: If the absorber operation is defective, use SST to remove the absorber from the outer shell and either replace the cartridge or overhaul it.
